title: The Invisible Bonds That Hold DNA Together
description:
DNA stores the blueprint of life, but what physically holds the double helix together?

Hydrogen bonds between base pairs, Adenine with Thymine and Guanine with Cytosine, are strong enough to stabilize the structure yet weak enough for enzymes to unzip during replication. A precise molecular balance that makes life possible.
